kind: late-layer FP16 norm/MLP leaf controls (source only)
scope: Isolate one real late decoder block's FP16 input_layernorm and MLP leaf operators against CPU FP16 oracles built from the actual captured native Half values. Local down_proj shard linear only: the row-parallel HCCL all-reduce is never executed here.

required_runtime_inputs.layer: real R79 MiniMaxH3Qwen3VLTextDecoderLayer on NPU, original Half params
required_runtime_inputs.block_input: actual Half (1,2043,5120); for block25 it is the unchanged CPU FP16 raw layer24 state
required_runtime_inputs.mlp_input: actual Half (1,2043,5120) captured by a pre-hook on the first native mlp.forward
required_runtime_inputs.compare: root helper compare(value, reference) -> dict with relative_rms/max_abs_error/raw_bits_equal
required_runtime_inputs.tensor_info: root helper tensor_info(value) -> dict with sha256

leaf_controls.input_layernorm: native FP16 two-round vs CPU two-round HF order, same original Half gamma/eps
leaf_controls.mlp_gate_up_local_linear: Half F.linear on the actual captured mlp input, gate rows[0:3200] and up rows[3200:6400]
leaf_controls.silu_on_actual_native_gate: F.silu on the actual native Half gate vs CPU Half SiLU on the same values; Float-SiLU is a labelled diagnostic only
leaf_controls.silu_times_up: Half elementwise product of the actual native activations
leaf_controls.down_proj_local_linear: local K3200->5120 shard linear on the same product; collective NOT executed
